messages:
Anya: quick mock attached — exploring a compact legend mode for narrow dashboard panels. goal: keep series color + short label, hide long unit text by default and reveal on hover/focus. preview: small pill glyphs + abbreviated unit (e.g., ms -> ms, tokens -> tk). Sam: this reads well. question: when we hide units are we still clear about scale (k, M) and smoothing? can cause misreads on single-panel embeds. :thinking_face: Jordan: agree with Sam. suggestion: show a subtle "i" affordance that expands a popover with full unit + smoothing state. keyboard-accessible (enter/space toggles). Leo: for accessibility we should include aria-label on the expand control and ensure focus outline stays visible. also consider a long-press tooltip on touch. Marta: microcopy options — two variants: compact vs explicit. formatting examples: ``` Compact: RTT · 12.3 ms Explicit: Round-trip time (p95) · 12.3 milliseconds ``` Which should be default for narrow vs wide panels? Anya: leaning compact as default for <360px width, explicit for >=360px. auto-switch based on panel width and user preference. Also want the legend collapse to respect per-route unit overrides (some teams prefer humanized bytes vs raw). Sam: operational note: if we dynamically swap text we need stable DOM IDs so user preferences persist across rollouts. also perf: avoid re-rendering the whole chart on hover — only the legend node should update. Jordan: UX nit: when smoothing is on, append a small subtle badge "sm" in legend; clicking badge toggles showing unsmoothed spikes in an overlay. that handles outlier preservation without changing the main view. Leo: implementation sketch (ARIA + keyboard): ```html
Round-trip time (p95) · smoothing: enabled
``` Focus moves to button, Enter toggles aria-hidden and toggles tooltip visibility. Marta: copy tweak: change "smoothing: enabled" -> "smoothed (5m window)" — it's clearer. and include a link to a docs modal: "Why smoothing matters". Anya: good call. Also UX question: for outlier handling, should the tooltip include a small sparkline of recent points? we can inline a 48px sparkline SVG to show spikes without re-running the chart. Sam: small sparkline sounds helpful. just be careful with color contrast on tiny elements. contrast ratio for the sparkline stroke should meet 3:1 at small sizes — check with design token palette. Jordan: accessibility checklist for this feature: keyboard operable expand, aria-describedby on legend item linking to popover id, focus trapping not needed (popover is non-modal), tooltips dismiss on Escape, touch long-press support. I'll add to the PR description. design-bot: deploy-preview built for branch `legend/compact-toggle` — preview url: https://staging.redwood.run/pr/3489. snapshot tests included for legend collapse states. Anya: leaving with action items: 1) Jordan — add aria attributes and keyboard flow doc (PR comments). 2) Sam — add stable DOM id plan + perf note. 3) Leo — spec focus styles and touch behaviour. 4) Marta — finalize microcopy and docs link text. I'll update the mock and push a small interaction prototype later today. :thumbsup:
